q: Which of the following is a scalar quantity?
exp: Mass has only magnitude (no direction), making it a scalar quantity.
ai_exp:
Scalar vs Vector Analysis:

• Scalar: Has only magnitude (size/amount)
• Vector: Has both magnitude AND direction

Let's classify each option:

Option A (Velocity): Speed + direction = VECTOR ✗
Option B (Force): Has magnitude + direction = VECTOR ✗
Option C (Mass): Only magnitude, no direction = SCALAR ✓ Correct!
Option D (Acceleration): Rate of change of velocity = VECTOR ✗

Velocity, Force, and Acceleration all require direction.
Mass (e.g., 5 kg) has no direction.

The correct answer is C) Mass.

q: What is the SI unit of electric current?
exp: The SI unit of electric current is the Ampere (A).
ai_exp:
SI Units Analysis:

• Volt (V) = Unit of electric potential difference ✗
• Ampere (A) = Unit of electric current ✓
• Ohm (Ω) = Unit of electrical resistance ✗
• Watt (W) = Unit of power ✗

Electric current is the rate of flow of electric charge.

Option A: Measures voltage, not current ✗
Option B: Measures current ✓ Correct!
Option C: Measures resistance ✗
Option D: Measures power ✗

The correct answer is B) Ampere.

q: A car travels 120 km in 2 hours. What is its average speed?
exp: Average speed = Total distance / Total time = 120/2 = 60 km/h.
ai_exp:
Average Speed Calculation:

Formula: Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Step 1: Identify values
• Distance = 120 km
• Time = 2 hours

Step 2: Apply formula
• Speed = 120 ÷ 2
• Speed = 60 km/h

Option A (30 km/h): 120/4, wrong time ✗
Option B (60 km/h): 120/2 = 60 ✓ Correct!
Option C (120 km/h): Forgot to divide by time ✗
Option D (240 km/h): Multiplied instead of dividing ✗

The correct answer is B) 60 km/h.

q: The acceleration due to gravity on Earth is approximately:
exp: Acceleration due to gravity on Earth is approximately 9.8 m/s².
ai_exp:
Gravitational Acceleration Analysis:

• Earth's gravity pulls objects toward its center
• The standard value is g = 9.8 m/s²
• This means velocity increases by 9.8 m/s every second

Option A (5.0): Too low, closer to Mars ✗
Option B (9.8): Standard Earth value ✓ Correct!
Option C (15.0): Too high ✗
Option D (20.0): Way too high ✗

The correct answer is B) 9.8 m/s².

q: Which law states that for every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction?
exp: Newton's Third Law states: For every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction.
ai_exp:
Newton's Laws Analysis:

• First Law (Inertia): Objects stay at rest or in motion unless acted upon
• Second Law: F = ma (Force = mass × acceleration)
• Third Law: Action = Reaction (equal and opposite)
• Law of Gravity: F = G(m₁m₂/r²)

Option A: About inertia ✗
Option B: About F = ma ✗
Option C: About action-reaction pairs ✓ Correct!
Option D: About gravitational force ✗

The correct answer is C) Newton's Third Law.

q: What is the frequency of a wave with a period of 0.5 seconds?
ai_exp:
Frequency Calculation:

Formula: f = 1/T
• Where f = frequency (Hz)
• T = period (seconds)

Step 1: Identify period
• T = 0.5 seconds

Step 2: Apply formula
• f = 1/0.5
• f = 2 Hz

Option A (0.5): Used period value directly ✗
Option B (1.0): Incorrect calculation ✗
Option C (2.0): 1/0.5 = 2 ✓ Correct!
Option D (5.0): Incorrect ✗

The correct answer is C) 2.0 Hz.

q: Which of the following is a good conductor of electricity?
exp: Copper is a metal and good conductor of electricity.
ai_exp:
Conductivity Analysis:

Good conductors:
• Metals (copper, silver, gold, aluminum)
• Have free electrons

Poor conductors (insulators):
• Rubber, glass, plastic
• Electrons tightly bound

Option A (Rubber): Insulator ✗
Option B (Glass): Insulator ✗
Option C (Copper): Metal conductor ✓ Correct!
Option D (Plastic): Insulator ✗

The correct answer is C) Copper.

q: The energy possessed by a body due to its motion is called:
exp: Kinetic energy is the energy of motion.
ai_exp:
Energy Types Analysis:

• Potential energy = Stored energy due to position
• Kinetic energy = Energy due to MOTION
• Chemical energy = Stored in chemical bonds
• Nuclear energy = Stored in atomic nucleus

A moving body has kinetic energy.
Formula: KE = ½mv²

Option A: Stored energy, not motion ✗
Option B: Energy of motion ✓ Correct!
Option C: Energy in bonds ✗
Option D: Energy in nucleus ✗

The correct answer is B) Kinetic energy.

q: What is the power of a device that uses 500 J of energy in 10 seconds?
ai_exp:
Power Calculation:

Formula: P = E/t
• P = Power (Watts)
• E = Energy (Joules)
• t = Time (seconds)

Step 1: Identify values
• E = 500 J
• t = 10 s

Step 2: Apply formula
• P = 500/10
• P = 50 W

Option A (25): 500/20, wrong time ✗
Option B (50): 500/10 = 50 ✓ Correct!
Option C (100): 500/5, wrong ✗
Option D (500): Forgot to divide ✗

The correct answer is B) 50 W.

q: Which electromagnetic wave has the shortest wavelength?
exp: Gamma rays have the shortest wavelength and highest frequency in the EM spectrum.
ai_exp:
Electromagnetic Spectrum Order (longest to shortest wavelength):

Radio → Microwave → Infrared → Visible → UV → X-ray → Gamma

Gamma rays:
• Shortest wavelength
• Highest frequency
• Highest energy

Option A (Radio): Longest wavelength ✗
Option B (Visible): Middle of spectrum ✗
Option C (X-rays): Short, but not shortest ✗
Option D (Gamma rays): Shortest ✓ Correct!

The correct answer is D) Gamma rays.
